description: Each element of an expanded argument is converted to its parameter's type
notes: The spec's function call rules make a call erroneous when an argument doesn't match its parameter's type specification, which only an identical type or the dynamic pseudo-type does, and don't mention converting arguments; only the general section on conversions says that automatic conversion is attempted when values don't match what an operation expects. hashicorp/hcl converts each argument to its parameter's type with go-cty's convert.Convert before checking it (FunctionCallExpr.Value in hclsyntax/expression.go), also for each element of an expanded argument, so 1 and true become "1" and "true".
